title: Repository-native implementation control plane

acceptance_gates.description: Control-plane tests cover repository validity, evidence enforcement, dependency cycles, phase progression, and next-package eligibility.
The dependency-free verifier returns zero errors for repository control state and non-zero for invalid fixtures.
GitHub Actions generates a control-plane report and PR status comment without repository secrets or auto-merge authority.
After FND-CTRL-001 is complete, the next command identifies FND-TEMP-001 as eligible Foundation work.

rollback: Revert the implementation-control-plane PR; all control-plane state is repository-only and introduces no external persistent resources.
